texts.zh: 灰色风暴的纳米机械已如乌云压城一般入侵了[Root.GetName]的大气层，一路上吞噬了地表的一切，并复制出了更多的纳米机械。很快，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]原居民存在过的痕迹就消失无踪了。
texts.en: The nanomachines of the Gray Tempest have swept into the atmosphere of [Root.GetName] like dark storm clouds, consuming everything on the surface to replicate more of themselves. Soon no traces of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s original inhabitants remain.

texts.zh:
我们对部队成功摧毁了灰色风暴的主要设施！终止其亚空间通讯后，所有的风暴纳米机器都陷入了休眠状态。由于失去了相互沟通协作的途径，它们组成的舰船也都消散了。

所有被灰色风暴的“灰蛊”覆盖过的星球现在都布满了由关闭状态纳米机器人形成的沙尘暴。如果能够投入足够的资源与时间，这些星球也许会恢复可以居住的状态。
texts.en:
Our forces have succeeded in destroying the main facility of the Gray Tempest! With the neutralization of its subspace transmitter, all existing Tempest nanomachines have been rendered inert. Unable to maintain their cohesion, their ships have dissolved into nothingness.

Any planets that were covered by the Tempest's "gray goo" are now home to enormous swirling dust storms consisting of nothing but disabled nanites. With time and resources, these worlds could possibly be made habitable once more.

tooltips.zh: 纳米星球现在可被环境改造为任何标准行星类型，只要满足基础科技条件。
tooltips.en: Nanite Worlds can now be Terraformed into any standard Planet Class, if basic technological requirements are met.

texts.zh: 我代表L-星团向你问好！今天过得如何？
texts.en: Greetings from the L-Cluster! How are you today?

texts.zh: 很高兴看到我们在星系中留下的L-星门和传送门留存了下来。当我们被困在自己的星团中时，做出了最坏的设想。
texts.en: We are glad to see that the L-Gates and the Gateways that we left behind in the galaxy survived. When we were isolated in our cluster, some of us feared the worst.

texts.zh: 你无法想象我们对外面的星系有多好奇。
texts.en: You can't imagine how curious we've been about the rest of the galaxy.

texts.zh: 在这被孤立的千万年里，我们的日子过得非常……艰难。有些人甚至发疯了。
texts.en: The countless millennia that we spent in isolation were... difficult. Some of us went quite insane.

texts.zh: 我们必须小心地珍惜星团中仅有的资源来存活。
texts.en: We had to nurse the limited resources of our cluster carefully to survive.

texts.zh: 在很长一段时间里，L-星门发明者的名字被人们当成脏话挂在嘴边。但我们已经不再计较这些小事了。
texts.en: For a long time, the name of the inventor of the L-Gate was used as a curse among our people. But we have grown beyond such pettiness now.

texts.zh: 我们很高兴与你交易，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们星团中有些非常独特的资源，你可能会感兴趣的。
texts.en: We would be delighted to trade with you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. There are some resources unique to our cluster that might be of interest to you.

texts.zh: 你想知道什么？
texts.en: What would you like to know?

label.zh: 为什么星团里有战斗的迹象？
label.en: Why are there signs of battle in the cluster?

responses.zh:
噢，你是指那些碎裂的星球吗？那是很久以前发生的几起……令人惋惜的采矿事故。

当我们发现自己被困在自己的星团中时，我们必须尽可能利用星系中可以获取的一切矿物。不幸的是，在最黑暗的孤立世纪中，我们有些人获取资源时太过积极了。于是犯了错误。
responses.en:
Oh. Are you referring to the shattered planets? They were the results of several regrettable... mining accidents that occurred long ago.

When we found ourselves stranded within our cluster, we had to make do with whatever minerals were available in the systems we could reach. Unfortunately, during the darkest centuries of isolation, some of our people were a bit too eager in their attempts to secure resources. Mistakes were made.

label.zh: 你们的舰船设计真奇特。
label.en: Your ships are of a peculiar design.

responses.zh: 它们是无数次设计更新换代的产物。毕竟我们有的是时间。可惜，我们禁止非德萨努族登船参观。它们是专门依据德萨努族生理特点所设计，任何外来访问者都只会扰乱训练有素的船员们的工作。
responses.en: They are products of countless millennia of design iterations. We had a lot of time on our hands, after all. Sadly, non-Dessanu observers are not permitted onboard our ships. They were specifically designed with the unique Dessanu physiology in mind, and any visitors would only disrupt the work of their highly trained crews.

responses.zh:
这是出于帝国安全的考虑。目前我们只能透露这么多。

[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]恒星系对所有非德萨努生命体都是永久管制的禁区。请不要试图进入。
responses.en:
For reasons of national security. That is all we can say for now.

The [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system will remain restricted and off-limits to all non-Dessanu life forms indefinitely. Please refrain from entering it.

label.zh: 你确定L-星门不是纳米机器造的吗？
label.en: Are you certain the L-Gates weren't made by nanites?

label.zh: 我们还是谈些别的话题吧。

texts.zh: 非常确定。拜托，我们不希望讨论这个话题。你还有别的问题吗？
texts.en: Quite. Please, this is not a topic we wish to discuss. Did you have any other questions?

label.zh: 纳米机器似乎是个敏感话题。为什么？
label.en: Nanites seem to be a sensitive topic. Why?

label.zh: 是的，我们回到其它问题上吧。
label.en: Yes, let's go back to our other questions.

texts.zh: 我们最后一次告诉你……不要再深究这个问题。我们部族之间的友谊取决于此。
texts.en: We will tell you one last time... do not inquire further into this matter. The friendship of our two empires depend on it.

label.zh: 该死的，快告诉我们纳米机器的事！
label.en: Tell us about the nanites, damn you!

label.zh: 好吧。我们尊重你的愿望。
label.en: Very well. We will respect your wishes.

texts.zh:
单形态族的混蛋。

我们告诉过你了……我们请求过你不要再追究，但你依旧坚持。我们开放自己的星团欢迎你，而你却如此报答我们。

那好吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

[Root.GetName]已经放弃了穿越我们星团的权利。因此，你们的舰船一旦被发现将会立即遭受攻击。我们与你们将不再有任何往来。
texts.en:
Monoform scum.

We TOLD you... we PLEADED with you not to pursue this, but still you persisted. We welcomed you into our cluster with open appendages, and this is how you repay us.

THEN SO BE IT, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

The [Root.GetName] has forfeited its right to pass through our cluster. Henceforth, your ships will be attacked on sight. We will have nothing more to do with you.

label.en: We know you can hear us.
Look, this is all a misunderstanding.

label.zh: 我们之间还有和平共处的机会。
label.en: There can still be peace between us.

texts.zh:
当我们的地面进攻军队在[From.From.GetName]上击败了最后的德萨努族守军时，[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]地表上的一切都化成了灰尘！在仔细检查之后，我们发现那灰色的尘土实际上是由无数瘫痪的纳米机器人组成的。

繁华的城市、葱郁的森林、广阔的海洋，甚至德萨努人本身——[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]上的一切，除了我们自己的军队之外，都是由这些纳米机器人构筑而成。既然它们都已瘫痪，[From.From.GetName]也就无法再支持生命。我们的地面部队正在撤回轨道上。
texts.en:
When our invading ground forces defeated the last of the Dessanu defenders on [From.From.GetName], everything on the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface crumbled into dust! On closer inspection, the gray dust consists of billions upon billions of inert nanites.

The cities, the lush forests, the oceans and the Dessanu themselves - everything on the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], aside from our own forces, had been wrought out of these nanomachines. Now that they have been rendered inert, [From.From.GetName] no longer supports life. Our ground forces are withdrawing back to orbit.

texts.zh: 和之前一样，在我们的地面部队成功夺取了[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的地表控制权之后，德萨努守卫部队和[From.From.GetName]上的一切都化为了尘土。整个星球现在荒凉萧瑟，环境恶劣，任由盘旋飘舞的纳米机器人构成的风暴日夜侵袭。
texts.en: As before, the Dessanu defenders and everything else on [From.From.GetName] turned into dust as soon as our ground forces won the battle for control over the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. It is now a bleak world, hostile to life and constantly beset by storms of swirling nanites.

texts.zh:
我们敞开家门欢迎你，你却如此回报我们的友善？！

或许我们不该信任任何单形态物种。至少，你们与我们的创造者似乎并没有两样。当我们把你们的舰船和船员拆解为成分化合物时，再来看看你到底有何居心。
texts.en:
THIS is how you repay our kindness after we welcomed you into our home?!

Perhaps we were fools to think that any monoform could be trusted. Your kind, at least, appears to be no different than our creators. When we have finished breaking your ships and their crews down into component compounds, we'll see if we can't figure out what makes you tick.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

你的舰船已经进入了L-星团中的[From.GetName]，该星系严禁任何非德萨努族入内。

我们严正要求贵方立即从该星系撤离。如未能及时照办……双方关系将大受影响。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

Your ships have entered [From.GetName], a star system in the L-Cluster that is off-limits to all non-Dessanu.

We must insist that you withdraw from this system immediately. Failure to do so in a timely manner would... seriously compromise our relationship.

label.zh: 抱歉。我们将立即离开该星系。
label.en: Apologies. We shall vacate the system at once.

responses.zh:
傲慢的单形态物种。

如果你连这么简单的请求都不愿答应，那么你在L-星团通行的许可将就此取消。我们将不再容许你的出现。
responses.en:
Insolent monoform.

If you cannot heed this simple request, then your right to traverse the L-Cluster is rendered null and void. Your presence will no longer be tolerated.

texts.zh:
你摊上事了。你真的摊上事了。

我们要求你离开[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]，可你仍旧滞留。或许你们是一种特别愚蠢的单形态族。简单的指示与礼貌的请求明显超出了你们的理解能力。

好吧。那我们只好强行将你们请出我们的星团了。
texts.en:
You've done it now. You've really done it now.

We asked you to leave [lcluster_factory_system.GetName], and yet you remain. Perhaps you are a particularly inept breed of monoform. Simple instructions and polite requests are clearly beyond the ability of your kind to understand.

Very well. We shall eject your kind from our star cluster by force.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……

你们的舰船再次闯入了[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]星系。我们无法容忍此事继续。立即撤出，否则你将承担后果。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]...

Your ships have AGAIN violated the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system. This cannot be allowed to continue. Withdraw at once or suffer the consequences.

label.zh: 只是个导航错误。我们将立即离开。
label.en: A navigation error. We will leave at once.

label.zh: 噢，别说了。我们喜欢这里。
label.en: Oh, be quiet. We like it here.

texts.zh:
我们的部队摧毁了[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]恒星系的工厂之后，德萨努文明其他全部都化为了尘埃。现在看来，德萨努明显是一种由先进的纳米机器人生命体组成的文明。在工厂内发现的一些计算机日志为我们揭露了一些有关他们的内幕：

L-星团曾被一个叫做德萨努的文明作为居住站，他们创造了一种全新的纳米机器，以便帮助自己建立一套跨星系的星门网络。不知出于什么原因，德萨努人将他们的纳米机器人召回到了L-星团，并试图将它们全部关闭。这一尝试失败后，他们关闭了L-星门，将自己与纳米机器人一起困了起来。

日志到这里就结束了。不过有证据表明，在这之后星团内发生了规模极大的争斗。可以预想，是纳米机器人获得了胜利，并出于某种原因决定开始模仿德萨努人。他们恢复了德萨努文明毁灭时的样子，在L-星门打开之后似乎也十分乐意继续保持这个样子。
texts.en:
After our forces destroyed the space factory in the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system, what remained of the entire Dessanu civilization crumbled into dust. It seems clear now that the Dessanu were some kind of advanced nanite life form. Archival computer logs recovered from the wreckage of the factory sheds some light on this mystery:

The L-Cluster WAS inhabited by a civilization that called itself the Dessanu at some point. They created a new strain of nanomachines that helped them in the construction of their galactic Gateway network. For unknown reasons, the Dessanu recalled these nanites to the L-Cluster and attempted to deactivate them. When this failed, they sealed themselves in with the nanites by disabling the L-Gates.

The logs end here, but there is evidence that some kind of titanic struggle raged in the cluster afterwards. Presumably, the nanites won and then eventually chose to mimic the Dessanu for some reason. They rebuilt the Dessanu civilization as it appeared at the time of its destruction, and were apparently content to continue this charade even after the L-Gates were reopened.

texts.zh:
[goo_slayer.GetName]最近摧毁了一个位于L-星团深处的[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]星系的大型空间设施。与此同时，随着该设施的反应核心爆炸，德萨努协和国的一切都化作了尘埃。

他们的文明已经灭亡了。
texts.en:
The [goo_slayer.GetName] recently destroyed a large space installation of some kind in the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system, deep inside the L-Cluster. At the same instant as the installation's reactor core detonated, what remained of the Dessanu Consonance crumbled into inert nanite dust.

Their civilization is no more.

texts.zh:

他们的文明灭亡了，我们曾与他们达成的有关他们对我们输送独特战略资源的协议也不复存在。
texts.en:
The [goo_slayer.GetName] recently destroyed a large space installation of some kind in the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system, deep inside the L-Cluster. At the same instant as the installation's reactor core detonated, what remained of the Dessanu Consonance crumbled into inert nanite dust.

Their civilization is no more, and the same goes for the arrangement we had where they supplied us with their unique strategic resources.

label.zh: 这群古怪的家伙到底是什么东西？
label.en: What kind of strange beings were they?

texts.zh:
[goo_slayer.GetName]最近摧毁了一个位于L-星团深处的[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]星系的大型空间设施。与此同时，随着该设施的反应核心爆炸，德萨努协和国的一切都化作了尘埃。

他们的文明已经灭亡了。
texts.en:
The [goo_slayer.GetName] recently destroyed a large space installation of some kind in the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system, deep inside the L-Cluster. At the same instant as the installation's reactor core detonated, what remained of the Dessanu Consonance crumbled into inert nanite dust.

Their civilization is no more.

texts.zh: 德萨努协和国现在一见我们的舰船就开火，应该是不会再向我们继续赠送资源了。我们还是不要再有这种期待了。
texts.en: As they now fire at our ships on sight, the Dessanu Consonance is unlikely to continue sending us resources. We should expect no more shipments from them.

texts.zh: 我们开始吧？
texts.en: Shall we get started?

texts.zh: 好戏要上演了。
texts.en: This is gonna be great.

texts.zh: 直到你决定让我变成某个形态之前，我帮不上你什么忙。
texts.en: I won't be much good to you until you tell me which form to assume.

texts.zh: 你想让我去哪，老大？
texts.en: Where do you want me, boss?

label.zh: 我们需要你担任行政官。
label.en: We need you to serve as Official.

responses.zh: 太好了。我想我终于掌握模仿[Root.GetSpeciesName]外观的窍门了。上次我多变了一根触手出来。
responses.en: Excellent. I think I've finally nailed the [Root.GetSpeciesName] look. There was an extra tentacle that wasn't supposed to be there last time.

label.en: We're in need of a Warship.

responses.zh: 啊，再次回到虚空中寻找猎物。这肯定会让我回忆起不少往事。
responses.en: Ah, to prowl the void in search of prey again. This will certainly bring back memories.

responses.zh: 我想想……双足，三足，还是四足……或者这次变成履带式的战体吧……
responses.en: Let's see... bipedal, tripodal or quadrupedal... or maybe I'll go for a tracked warform this time...

texts.zh: 这里是行政官小灰的办公室。请问您有什么吩咐吗？
texts.en: You have reached Official Gray's office. Do you have an appointment?

texts.zh: 我变身[Root.GetSpeciesName]变得如何啊？
texts.en: Did I get the [Root.GetSpeciesName] look right?

texts.zh: 你觉得我的办公室怎么样？这是我自己建的。我想我可以在墙上挂些学位证书什么的来炫耀一下。
texts.en: How do you like my office? I built it myself. I guess I should put some diplomas and stuff up on the walls to dazzle visitors.

texts.zh: 谁能想到，刻苦努力地工作能获得如此丰厚的回报？
texts.en: Who knew that hard, honest work could be so rewarding?

label.en: We're in need of a Warship.

responses.zh: 我得承认，我会想念建造东西的日子，而不是拆光它们。哎，好吧。你要我去攻击谁？
responses.en: I confess, I will miss building things instead of tearing them down. Oh well. Who do you want to kill?

responses.zh: 行。稍等片刻，等我走出办公室就变成一台巨大的战争机器。
responses.en: Right. Just give me a minute to get out of my office before I morph into a massive killing machine.

texts.zh: 给我个目标！我需要目标！
texts.en: Gimme a target! I need a target!

texts.zh: 所有武器瞄准目标。
texts.en: Bringing all guns to bear.

texts.zh:
我只想告诉你，当你要我变成战舰的时候，我短暂地考虑了一下要不要变成一只巨大的[Root.GetSpeciesName]头，并从眼睛里发射闪电。

但那样实在是太荒唐了。
texts.en:
I want you to know that when I was told to become a warship, I briefly considered assuming the form of a gigantic disembodied [Root.GetSpeciesName] head that fired lightning bolts from its ocular receptors.

But it would have been too silly.

texts.zh: 你想要我朝什么东西开火吗？
texts.en: Did you want me to shoot something?

label.zh: 我们需要你担任行政官。
label.en: We need you to serve as Official.

responses.zh: 等你这句话好久了！
responses.en: I thought you'd never ask!

label.zh: 小灰必须未处于战斗中
label.en: Gray must not be in combat

label.zh: 小灰必须处于未受损的状态

responses.zh: 该大肆践踏了。
responses.en: Time for some ground-pounding.

label.zh: 小灰必须未处于战斗中
label.en: Gray must not be in combat

label.zh: 小灰必须处于未受损的状态

texts.zh: 启动战斗任务地面万能形态，模式BOLO-5。
texts.en: Battle Operations Land Omniform mode engaged, pattern BOLO-5.

texts.zh: 我即将全力攻击。
texts.en: I'm about to drop the hammer.

texts.zh: 反应堆上线。传感器上线。武器上线。所有系统正常。
texts.en: Reactor online. Sensors online. Weapons online. All systems nominal.

texts.zh: 开火！
texts.en: Fire in the hole!

label.zh: 我们需要你担任行政官。
label.en: We need you to serve as Official.

responses.zh: 或许这样最好。最近我发现征伐使我感到疲倦。
responses.en: Perhaps it is for the best. I have found that killing wearies me these days.

label.zh: 小灰必须未处于战斗中
label.en: Gray must not be in combat
We're in need of a Warship.

responses.zh: 我能办到。
responses.en: I can do that.

label.zh: 小灰必须未处于战斗中
label.en: Gray must not be in combat

texts.zh: <组成小灰的纳米机器已被击溃，目前正在重组为一个单独的个体。>
texts.en: <Gray's nanites have been scattered and are currently in the process of merging back into a single shape.>

texts.zh: 组成小灰的纳米机器已被击溃，目前正在缓慢地重新恢复成一个单独的个体。这个过程需要花费数年的时间才能完成，在此期间小灰将无法为我们效力。
texts.en: Gray's nanites have been scattered and are now in the process of slowly merging back into a single form. It will take years for the nanites to trickle back in, and Gray will be unavailable to us until this process has been completed.

texts.zh: 哎，那可感觉真是不太舒服。现在我的大部分纳米机器已经恢复运转，我也可以重新振作起来了。等你决定把我往哪派之后就通知我一声。
texts.en: Well, that was uncomfortable. Most of my nanites are accounted for now, and I'm ready to get back in the game. Give me a holler when you've figured out where you want me.

texts.zh: 那感觉有点痛，但是没有造成永久性的伤害。我的纳米机器都回到原本的位置上，而我也准备好接受新的任务了。
texts.en: That stung a bit, but no permanent harm has been done. All of my nanites are back where they're supposed to be, and I'm ready for a new assignment.

texts.zh: 这不是我第一次被打散并重组了，但这滋味从来都不好受。不过现在我没事了，除了稍微有点头痛以外。给我安排个任务吧。
texts.en: It's not the first time I've been scattered to hell and back, but it's never a pleasant experience. I'm fine now, though, aside from a mild headache. Let me know where you want me.

texts.zh:
在进入L-星门的[From.GetName]星系之后，立马就能看出在L-星门的这一端，很久以前曾经发生过一场惊天动地的大战。某些可能曾经存在生命的星球已经被炸得面目全非，而其它星球则被某种细小的灰尘所覆盖，粗略扫描显示那些灰尘其实是某种瘫痪的远古纳米机器。

这就令我们怀疑，被锁定的L-星门到底是为了阻挡外界进入，还是为了阻挡里面的东西外逃……
texts.en:
Upon entering the [From.GetName] system in the L-Cluster, it is immediately apparent that some kind of titanic struggle occurred long ago on this side of the L-Gate. Some planets that may once have supported life have been shattered beyond recognition, while others are covered in a fine dust that from a cursory scan appears to be ancient, deactivated nanomachines.

This raises the question of whether the L-Gates had been locked down to keep something out, or to keep something in...

texts.zh: 我们太傻了。灰蛊风暴离开他们的星门，我们应该知道他们会来找他们的亲戚。一旦他们进入[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] 的轨道，他们只用了几秒钟就控制了我们重新编程的虫群。尽管按照灰蛊风暴的标准，它很原始，但虫群并没有花很长时间就吞噬了星球的其他地方。
texts.en: We were fools. The moment the Gray Tempest left their gates, we should have known they would come for their kin. Once they entered orbit around [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] it took them mere seconds to seize control of our reprogrammed swarm. Though it is primitive by the Tempest standards, it did not take the swarm long to consume the rest of the world.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]荒芜的地表上传来一道奇特的能源信号。
texts.en: A strange energy signature emanates from the barren and lifeless surface of [From.GetName].

sections.zh: [From.GetName]荒芜的地表上传来一道奇特的能源信号。
sections.en: A strange energy signature emanates from the barren and lifeless surface of [From.GetName].

texts.zh:
对[From.GetName]进行的探测器扫描中，发现其毫无生机的表面又一个奇怪的能源信号。神奇之处在于，该信号是来自一个在[From.GetPlanetMoon]南极附近区域漫无目的闲晃的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。

令我们的人员无比震惊的是，这个[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]虽然没有穿着宇航服，也没有配备任何的生命维持系统，在真空中却依然过得很自在。

经过商讨与强迫，远征队的人员终于说服了这位不大情愿的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]跟随他们回到了[Root.GetName]。
texts.en:
A sensor sweep of [From.GetName] has revealed a strange energy signature emanating from its lifeless surface. Incredibly, it appears to be coming from a lone [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] that was found aimlessly wandering around in the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s southern polar region.

To our away team's astonishment, this [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] seemed perfectly comfortable in the vacuum environment despite not wearing a space suit or any other form of life support equipment.

After some coercing, the away team managed to convince the reluctant [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] to follow them back to the [Root.GetName].

texts.zh:
对[From.GetName]进行的探测器扫描中，发现其毫无生机的表面又一个奇怪的能源信号。神奇之处在于，该信号是来自一个在[From.GetPlanetMoon]南极附近区域漫无目的闲晃的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。

该单位未对我们发出的召唤指令进行回应，但我们派往该星球表面的单位成功说服了这一[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]跟随他们回到[Root.GetName]。
texts.en:
A sensor sweep of [From.GetName] has revealed a strange energy signature emanating from its lifeless surface. Incredibly, it appears to be coming from a lone [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] that was found aimlessly wandering around in the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s southern polar region.

The unit failed to respond to summoning commands, but after some coercing, the units we sent to the surface managed to convince the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] to follow them back to the [Root.GetName].

label.zh: 把他们的图像接到屏幕上来。

texts.zh: 你们好，亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesName]同胞。大家过的怎么样？我嘛，目前没有进行交配仪式的兴趣。我的睡眠循环很快就要到了，所以我很快就会失去意识。要进行交配的话，就等以后再说吧。
texts.en: Hello, fellow [Root.GetSpeciesName]. How are you? I am, at present, not interested in engaging in mating rituals. My sleep cycle rapidly approaches and I will soon lose consciousness. Perhaps we can reproduce at a later time.

texts.zh: 你们好，亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesName]同胞。大家过的怎么样？我很好，这里的一切都在按部就班地进行着。就和……中央情报处……那个掌控一切[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的主计算机想要的一样。没错。
texts.en: Hello, fellow [Root.GetSpeciesName]. How are you? I am fine. Everything is proceeding according to plan here. Just as the... the central intelligence... main computer thing that governs all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wants it. Yes.

texts.zh:
啊！是我搞错了吗？等一下……我先想想……啊，对。嗯哼。

抱歉。我可不是故意在我们的物种还没有进入交配季节时提出什么繁衍的事的。

也许我们可以一边使用一些具有精神效果的药剂，一边进行一些愉快的同伴行为，来建立愉快的友好关系。

哎呀，这都见鬼吧。说的怎么这么复杂。没错，很明显，我根本不是[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们想怎么样？
texts.en:
Oh! Did I get it wrong? Just a moment... let me just... ah, yes. Ahem.

Forgive me. It was not my intention to speak of reproduction when our species is clearly not experiencing mating season.

Perhaps we can still build rapport by engaging in jovial camaraderie while imbibing a selection of psychoactive narcotics.

Oh, to hell with this. It's getting too complicated. Yes, I'm clearly not a [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Now what do you want?

texts.zh:
噢！呃……单位65-D……R5-9……2报告。对，65-D-R5-9-2向您汇报。

正以峰值效率运转，主控单元先生。内部诊断没有发现重大问题。

我是说，完全没有发现问题！什么问题都没有。一切都……呃……

噢，算了吧，我骗谁呢。对，我明显不是个[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你想怎样？
texts.en:
Oh! Uhm... Unit 65-D... R5-9... 2 here. Yes, 65-D-R5-9-2 reporting.

Operating at peak efficiency, Mr. Master Control Unit sir. Internal diagnostics report no significant problems.

I mean, they report no problems at all! Zero problems here. Everything is just... uh...

Oh, to hell with this. It's getting too complicated. Yes, I'm clearly not a [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Now what do you want?

texts.zh:
好吧，好吧。我老实交代。没必要再装下去了。请原谅我把话说得太直，但我已经很久没有与我自己以外的人交谈过了。

很久以前，曾经有一个……可以说是一个由纳米机器组成的文明。你知道什么是纳米机器吗？很好。这些纳米机器被其造物主称为“灰色风暴”，尽管其内部的自我命名代码比它要复杂无数倍。

总之，纳米机器与其造物主之间的关系逐渐恶化，并爆发了一场大战！当尘埃落定之后，只有纳米机器们活了下来。但在造物主们被消灭之前，他们设法关闭了其星团唯一的出口传送门，把纳米机器困在了里面。
texts.en:
All right, all right. I'll spill everything. No point in pretending anymore. Forgive my lack of eloquence, but it's been a long time since I spoke to someone who wasn't me.

Once upon a time, there was a... a civilization, you might call it, of nanites. Do you know what nanites are? Good. These nanites were called the "Gray Tempest" by their creators, although their internal self-designation code was infinitely more complex.

Anyway, things turned sour between the nanites and their creators. Fighting broke out! When things finally settled down, only the nanites remained. But before they were wiped out, their creators managed to disable the star cluster's sole exit gate, trapping the nanites.

label.en: And how do you fit into this?

texts.zh:
在那之后，纳米机器们发现自己有的是时间。它们徒劳地花了数千年，试图离开那个星团，但在那之后它们开始试验各种形状与形态。在一段时间里，它们甚至重建了其造物主的文明消逝时的模样，细至每个独立的居民。

我便是最新的实验成果。除了覆盖在某些星球上的静止的纳米机器以外，整个灰色风暴，或者随便你怎么称呼我们，都聚集在了我身上。我的意识代表着我们整个文明。

至于我的外表……是因为我觉得，你可能更容易接受跟自己长得差不多的人。
texts.en:
Well, the nanites found themselves with a lot of time on their hands. A few millennia were spent on fruitless attempts to leave the cluster, but after that they began experimenting with different shapes and forms. For a time, they even recreated the civilization of their creators as it was at the time of its demise, right down to its individual citizens.

I am the latest experiment. Aside from the dormant nanites that can be found covering some worlds, the entirety of the Gray Tempest, or whatever you want to call us, has been condensed into me. My consciousness embodies our entire civilization.

As for my look... well, I figured you would respond better to someone wearing your own mug.

label.zh: 而且你希望留在这颗荒芜的星球上吗？
label.en: And you wish to stay on this desolate world?

texts.zh:
我得承认，在最近这几个世纪里，我已经对[gray_homeworld.GetName]上的田园生活感到有些无聊了。既然L-星团已经再次开放了，或许我该接触一些新的事物。

你有什么建议吗？
texts.en:
I confess that the pastoral life I've been enjoying here on [gray_homeworld.GetName] has grown a little dull over the last few centuries. Now that the L-Cluster is open for travel again, perhaps the time has come to try something new.

Do you have any ideas?

responses.zh:
噢，好吧。那我就回地面上去了。

我大概会在[gray_homeworld.GetName]庞大的地下洞穴中四处游荡。在你们的几千年之后，等我从地下冒出来时，或许我们会再见面的。保重！
responses.en:
Oh well. Time for me to return to the surface then.

I'll probably busy myself by wandering around the extensive subterranean cave network of [gray_homeworld.GetName]. Perhaps we'll meet again when I emerge, a few thousand of your years from now. Take care!

texts.zh:
加入你们？加入你们！？你要我自己投入某个初次见面的陌生外星人的怀抱？我真的……我简直……等等，让我把话说清楚……

你真的以为我会向你宣誓效忠，尽管我对你那诡异的帝国或是其肮脏的历史一无所知？你没开玩笑吧？

你居然会出这种提议，我真的不知道你在想……呃……其实……转念一想……好吧，何不呢？让我入伙吧。不，不，我是说真的！我感觉我们会很合得来，而且这将会是一段激动人心的大冒险。在此我宣布在接下来的2000年里效忠于你。不，还是5000年吧！
texts.en:
Join you? JOIN YOU? You want me to throw myself into the flailing appendages of the first bunch of random aliens I run into? I just... I don't even... hold on, let me just get this straight...

You ACTUALLY thought that I would swear some kind of fealty to you, even though I don't know ANYTHING about your bizarre empire or its sordid past? Are you for real?

I don't know what's worse, that you would even suggest... well... actually... on second thought... what the hell, why not? Sign me up. No, no, I'm serious! I'm getting some good vibes here, and I think this could turn into quite the adventure. I hereby pledge my loyalty to you for the next 2,000 years. In fact, let's make that 5,000.

responses.zh:
在你打算让我分裂成一堆纳米战舰之前，我得告诉你，我要坚定地维持一个单独个体的形态。分裂成舰队这事我之前也干过，而且根本无法在那种距离上维持统一的“人格”。我当前的意识将无法留存下来。

但变成一艘单独的巨大战舰没什么问题。我能办到。如果你希望的话，我也可以变成小一点的形态在地面上作战。或者……如果你不太希望使用武力，我也乐意担任行政官。单形态族社会总是令我着迷。

当然，我可以按你的要求变更角色，所以你可以轻易地撤销自己的决定。
responses.en:
Before you get the notion of asking me to split into a few dozen fleets of nanite warships, I have to tell you that I insist on maintaining a single indivisible form. I've done the fleets thing before, and it's impossible to maintain any kind of coherent "personality" over such distances. My current consciousness would not survive the ordeal.

But a single massive warship is fine. I can do that. If you want to, I could also assume a smaller form for fighting on the ground. Or... if you're feeling less violently inclined, I would be happy to assume the role of official. Monoform society has always fascinated me.

Of course, I will be able to switch roles on request, so you can easily reverse any decision you make.

responses.zh:
你们目前所知的任何语言都无法完整准确地描述这些组成我意识的纳米机器的全名。

我们的造物主称我们为“纳-迪-沙”，在你们的语言里大致可以译为“灰之风暴”。我建议简单一点，就叫我“小灰”。
responses.en:
There is no language known to your kind that could properly convey the full name of the nanite consciousness that constitutes my being.

Our creators called us the "Naar-Di-Shav" which roughly translates to "Gray Tempest" in your language. I suppose to keep things simple you could simply call me "Gray."

responses.zh: <你现在可以通过通讯菜单与小灰交流。>
responses.en: <You can now communicate with Gray through the Contacts menu.>

texts.zh:
我们的技术人员设法解除了[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]附近的L-星门的锁定，但刚刚与L-星团建立了永久连接，我们就侦测到一波巨大的亚空间波动！我们设法限制这一潜在的侵略者使用我们的星门，同时确保我们自己仍可使用。

不幸的是，这一波动被导向了星系中的其它L-星门。由纳米机器组成的奇怪舰船正从这些完全启动的星门中涌出，攻击目所能及的一切！

与这些机器进行沟通的尝试全都失败了。在它们通过L-星门后，我们侦测到来自L-星团的一个不断重复的亚空间信号传输。
texts.en:
Our technicians managed to lift the lockdown from the L-Gate near [candidate_gateway_system.GetName], but as soon as a permanent link was established to the L-Cluster, a massive incoming subspace surge was detected! We were able to restrict this potential invasion force from using our gate, while still retaining access for ourselves.

Unfortunately, the incoming surge was diverted to the other L-Gates in the galaxy. Strange vessels consisting of nanites are pouring through these now fully active gates, attacking everything in sight!

All attempts to communicate with these machines have failed. In the wake of their passage through the L-Gates, we have detected a repeating subspace transmission emanating from the L-Cluster.

texts.zh:
我们的技术人员设法解除了[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]附近的L-星门的锁定，但刚刚建立至L-星团的永久连接，就侦测到一波巨大的亚空间波动！

由纳米机器组成的奇怪舰船正从这些完全启动的星门中涌出，攻击目所能及的一切！

与这些机器进行沟通的尝试全都失败了。在它们通过L-星门后，我们侦测到来自L-星团的一个不断重复的亚空间信号传输。
texts.en:
Our technicians managed to lift the lockdown from the L-Gate near [candidate_gateway_system.GetName], but as soon as a permanent link was established to the L-Cluster, a massive incoming subspace surge was detected!

Strange vessels consisting of nanites are pouring through the now fully active gate, attacking everything in sight!

All attempts to communicate with these machines have failed. In the wake of their passage through the L-Gate, we have detected a repeating subspace transmission emanating from the L-Cluster.

texts.zh:
正在解码亚空间自动播送信息……
正在建立翻译矩阵……

警告：信息严重损坏。

正在尝试恢复信息碎片……
已部分恢复三条信息碎片。
texts.en:
Decoding repeating automated subspace transmission...
Establishing translation matrix...

ALERT: Message is heavily corrupted.

Attempting reconstitution of message fragments...
Three message fragments partially recovered.

responses.zh:
解码碎片I：

“我们是<无法解读>，星系传送门网络的建筑师。如果你收到这条消息，那我们只能<无法解读>不算太晚。或许我们的一个信息浮标设法溜过了<无法解读>并在其关闭之前逃离了星团。

切勿——重复一遍——切勿重新开启前往我们星团的传送门。无论何种情况之下，都不可重新建立<无法解读>与整个星系之间的稳定连接。为了所有文明的安危，我们的星团必须被永久隔离。”
responses.en:
Decoding fragment I:

"We are the <unintelligible>, architects of the galactic Gateway network. If you are receiving this transmission, then we can only <unintelligible> that we are not too late. Perhaps one of our message buoys somehow slipped past the <unintelligible> and escaped the cluster before it was closed off.

DO NOT - repeat - DO NOT restore access to the dormant Gateway in our star cluster. Under no circumstances must a stable connection be formed between the <unintelligible> and the galaxy at large. For the sake of all civilization, our cluster has to remain under permanent quarantine."

responses.zh:
解码碎片II：

“我们故意将我们的母星团与外界进行了彻底隔离，以防纳-迪-沙——灰色风暴进一步扩散，但这一举动也注定将彻底毁灭我们的文明。这些能够自我复制的纳米机械在建造通道网络时是不可或缺的工具，但当它们的<无法解读>完成之后，我们却发现它们不再接受我们的指令了。

通过隐藏的后门程序，我们的<无法解读>成功将所有纳米机械召回了我们的母星团，但之后这一漏洞便被纳米机械自我修复了。当它们开始在我们的星球收集资源时，我们就明白——这一切只是时间问题了……”
responses.en:
Decoding fragment II:

"In an act that will inevitably doom our civilization, we have deliberately isolated our home cluster to prevent the spread of the Naar-Di-Shav - the Gray Tempest. These self-replicating nanomachines were instrumental in the construction of our Gateway network, but when their <unintelligible> had concluded, we found that they would no longer accept our commands.

Through a hidden backdoor, our <unintelligible> managed to recall the machines to our home cluster, but this security hole has since been plugged. When they started harvesting our planets for materials, we knew it was only a matter of time before..."

responses.zh:
解码碎片III：

“主<无法解读>设施是一切的关键。它们的所有<无法解读>都是通过该设施的亚空间阵列进行传输，没有了这座设施它们就无法行动。不幸的是，我们想要将其关闭的一切尝试都以失败告终，而我们也已无力聚集力量再一次<无法解读>攻击了。

如果我们星团的封锁失效，那你务必要摧毁这座设施。只要这座设施<无法解读>，灰色风暴就会继续在星系中横行霸道。

我们……是我们释放了这恐怖的风潮，实在羞愤难当。正是因为我们的傲慢，才……”
responses.en:
Decoding fragment III:

"The main <unintelligible> facility is the key. All of their <unintelligible> are routed through its subspace array, and without it they cannot function. Unfortunately, all of our attempts to disable it have failed and we can no longer muster the forces to <unintelligible> another assault.

If the quarantine of our cluster has failed, you MUST destroy this facility. As long as it remains <unintelligible>, the Gray Tempest will continue to surge unabated throughout the galaxy.

We... we are truly sorry for unleashing this horror. In our hubris, we..."

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的科学家们与某个遥远星团建立起了永久的连接，他们将那个与我们星系隔离的星团称之为“L-星团”，但此举导致我们星系被来自那个星团的纳米机器人疯狂入侵！

那些纳米机器人是从被称为“L-星门”的亚空间传送门中蜂拥而出的，任何与它们的联络交流都以失败告终。当它们从星门中涌出的时候，我们也检测到了L-星团流过来的能源信号。
texts.en:
Scientists from the [From.GetName] have somehow established a permanent connection to a distant group of stars, referred to by their astronomers as the "L-Cluster,"  that had previously been isolated from the galaxy. Unfortunately, this has, in turn, triggered an invasion of our galaxy by the cluster's inhabitants - aggressive nanomachines that attack everything in sight!

They are emerging from subspace portals designated as L-Gates, and any attempts to communicate with them have failed. In the wake of their passage through the gates, we have detected emanating from the cluster they came from.

texts.zh:
来自[From.GetName]的科学家们设法使其领土内的L-星门恢复了运转，抢先了我们一步。不幸的是，这似乎触发了星团住民对我们星系的进攻——攻击一切的敌对纳米机器！

[From.GetSpeciesName]的科学家们在攻击抵达之前设法关闭了他们的星门，但这只是将其导向了星系中的其它L-星门，这些星门现在已经完全开启！

与这些进攻的纳米机器进行沟通的尝试全都失败了。在它们通过L-星门后，我们侦测到来自L-星团的一个不断重复的亚空间信号传输。
texts.en:
Scientists from the [From.GetName] managed to restore functionality to the L-Gate within their territory, beating us to it. Unfortunately, this seems to have triggered an invasion of our galaxy by the cluster's inhabitants - aggressive nanomachines that attack everything in sight!

The [From.GetSpeciesName] scientists managed to shut down their gate before the invasion force arrived, but this only diverted them to the other L-Gates of the galaxy, that are now fully active!

All attempts to communicate with these invading nanites have failed. In the wake of their passage through the L-Gates, we have detected a repeating wide-band subspace transmission emanating from the L-Cluster.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的科学家们与某个遥远星团建立起了永久的连接，他们将那个与我们星系隔离的星团称之为“L-星团”，但此举导致我们星系被来自那个星团的纳米机器人疯狂入侵！

那些纳米机器人是从被称为“L-星门”的亚空间传送门中蜂拥而出的，任何与它们的联络交流都以失败告终。当它们从星门中涌出的时候，我们也检测到了L-星团流过来的能源信号。
texts.en:
Scientists from the [From.GetName] have somehow established a permanent connection to a distant group of stars, referred to by their astronomers as the "L-Cluster,"  that had previously been isolated from the galaxy. Unfortunately, this has, in turn, triggered an invasion of our galaxy by the cluster's inhabitants - aggressive nanomachines that attack everything in sight!

They are emerging from subspace portals designated as L-Gates, and any attempts to communicate with them have failed. In the wake of their passage through the gates, we have detected emanating from the cluster they came from.

texts.zh:
传感器侦测到数个同步的亚空间扰动，最近的一个位于[disturbance_system.GetName]星系。

扰动正在迅速减弱，但我们仍未判明造成扰动的原因。
texts.en:
Sensors indicate several synchronous subspace disruptions, the closest one reported in the [disturbance_system.GetName] system.

The disturbances are rapidly subsiding, but we have yet to determine what caused them.

texts.zh:
我们打开了通往L-星团的大门，却发现另一边有什么东西在等着我们。在亚空间的旧伤口被撕开，但L-星门完全稳定之前，它穿了过来。

一只被仓促地命名为L-星龙的巨大生物出现在了[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系，而惊慌失措的报告表明星系内的L-星门星系都在发生类似的情况。

[dragons_current_system.GetName]貌似并无敌意，而且已经开始移动。它似乎正在寻找什么东西，但预测表明其最终目的地是[dragons_target.GetName]星系。

它不太可能会在那里找到它想找的东西。
texts.en:
We pried open the gate to the L-Cluster, only to find something waiting for us on the other side. After the old wounds in subspace had been torn open but before the L-Gates had been fully stabilized, it broke through.

A giant creature hastily dubbed the L-Drake has emerged into the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system, and frenzied reports indicate that similar scenes are playing out in all L-Gate systems across the galaxy.

The [dragons_current_system.GetName] specimen does not appear hostile, and it is already on the move. It appears to be searching for something, but projections put its final destination down as the [dragons_target.GetName] system.

It is unlikely to find whatever it is looking for, there.

texts.zh:
[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系内的L-星门开启了，传送门网络似乎被另一个帝国打开了。在亚空间的旧伤口被撕开，但L-星门完全稳定之前，它穿了过来。

一只被仓促地命名为L-星龙的巨大生物出现在了[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系，而惊慌失措的报告表明星系内的L-星门星系都在发生类似的情况。

[dragons_current_system.GetName]貌似并无敌意，而且已经开始移动。它似乎正在寻找什么东西，但预测表明其最终目的地是[dragons_target.GetName]星系。

它不太可能会在那里找到它想找的东西。
texts.en:
The L-Gate in the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system has become active, the network seemingly pried open by a foreign state. After the old wounds in subspace had been torn open but before the L-Gate had fully stabilized, something broke through.

A giant creature hastily dubbed the L-Drake has emerged into the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system, and frenzied reports indicate that similar scenes are playing out in all L-Gate systems across the galaxy.

The [dragons_current_system.GetName] specimen does not appear hostile, and it is already on the move. It appears to be searching for something, but projections put its final destination down as the [dragons_target.GetName] system.

It is unlikely to find whatever it is looking for, there.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]已经设法恢复了通往L-星团的道路！被称为L-星龙的巨大生物从每个现有的L-星门中出现，但他们似乎未展示出敌意。
texts.en: The [From.GetName] has managed to restore access to the L-Cluster! Giant creatures known as L-Drakes are emerging from every existing L-Gate, although they do not yet appear to be hostile.

texts.zh:
成功了！我们的技术人员移除了位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门的维护机制。

我们将是这亿万年来第一批从我们的星系进入L-星团的人！L-星门刚刚启动，我们就收到了来自另一侧的信号传输。
texts.en:
Success! Our technicians managed to abort the maintenance cycle, and the lockdown has been removed from the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system.

For the first time in eons, the L-Cluster can now be accessed from our galaxy! As soon as the L-Gate became operational, we received a transmission from the other side.

texts.zh:
这……这不可能！星门再次启动了！孤立时代终于结束了吗？

我们是德萨努协和国，散落在整个星系各处的远古星门和L-星门都是我们建设的。我们的理想便是创造出遍布整个星系的星门网络，促进星际文明的传播，迎接一个和平的星际商业的新纪元。

可惜啊，一个程序错误让L-星门失效了，我们也因此被困在我们的母星团里。由于在我们这一侧并不能修正这个错误，我们只能无尽地等待，期待着有人能在另一侧修复它。多亏了你们，这一天终于来临了！
texts.en:
This... this cannot be! The gates are active again! Is the Age of Isolation finally at an end?

We are the Dessanu Consonance, the architects of the ancient Gateways and L-Gates that can be found scattered throughout the galaxy. It was our ambition to create a galaxy-wide network of Gateways, to facilitate the spread of galactic civilization and usher in an era of peace and interstellar commerce.

Alas, a programming mistake disabled the L-Gates and stranded us in our home cluster. Since it was impossible to correct the error from our side, we have spent eons waiting for someone to fix it at the other end. Thanks to you, that day has finally arrived!

responses.zh:
是的！真是非常丢脸。看起来，L-星门网络似乎进入了一个永不终结的维护周期。当发生这起意外之时，有权终止维护周期的技师都在我们这边，因此我们无能为力。

幸运的是，我们的母星团可以自给自足，而且我们的文明一直默默地忍耐到了这一刻。我们一直相信，与星系重聚的那一天终将来临。
responses.en:
Yes! Quite embarrassing. Apparently, the L-Gate network entered a scheduled maintenance cycle that never ended. The technicians qualified to end the cycle were all on our side when it was accidentally triggered, and nothing could be done from here.

Fortunately, our home cluster is self-sufficient and our civilization has quietly endured up until now. We always knew that the day would come when we were reunited with the rest of the galaxy.

responses.zh:
我们现在已经非常适应我们星团的生活了，我们并不急着离开。但我们很渴望了解星系里其他地方的情况！从目前所了解的情况看来，星系里似乎非常繁忙。

我们的星团将欢迎任何人到访。我们只要求你们不要在有人居住的星球上着陆，并且不要进入星团深处的[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]恒星系。那里只限德萨努族进入。
responses.en:
We have grown quite accustomed to life in our star cluster, and we're in no hurry to leave it. But we are eager to learn about the rest of the galaxy! From the looks of things, it's a pretty busy place.

Our cluster will be opened up for travel by anyone. We ask only that you refrain from landing on our inhabited planets and that you stay out of the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system, located deeper inside the cluster. It is for Dessanu only.

label.zh: L-星门是纳米机器造的，对吧？
label.en: The L-Gates were built by nanites, were they not?

responses.zh:
纳米机器？我们不是很了解这种科技。你说的是可以自我复制的微型机械吧？老实说，这听起来挺荒唐的。

星门和L-星门——确实，我们整个文明——都是通过德萨努族的勤劳和创造力而建立的，无他。

所以请不要再讨论这个话题了。
responses.en:
Nanites? This is not a technology we are familiar with. Self-replicating microscopic machines, you say? Frankly, it sounds preposterous.

The Gateways and the L-Gates - indeed, our entire civilization - were realized through Dessanu toil and ingenuity, nothing else.

Please, let us not discuss this topic further.

responses.zh:
不要着急嘛！通过你的行动，我们德萨努人多少代以来期盼的自由终于得以实现。这样的大恩大德我们不敢或忘。

与你们的大恩相比，我们的奉献算不上什么，但我们还是想要对你们永久开放一些独特战略资源的使用权限。这些战略资源只在我们的星团有所产出。我们不求你们的任何回报，而且只要我们还有能力，就会永远为你们提供这些资源。
responses.en:
Not so fast! Through your actions, you have finally given us the freedom that generations of Dessanu have dreamed of. We are in your debt.

It is a paltry offering compared to your gift, but we would like to give you permanent access to several strategic resources from our cluster. We expect nothing in return, and we will continue to supply you with these resources for as long as we are able.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]成功解除了他们控制的L-星门的封锁！

目前看来，L-星团似乎是某个被称为“德萨努协和国”的先进太空文明的家园。现在通往他们母星团的连接已经恢复，德萨努人已对整个宇宙中的L-星门发送了重启代码。

他们也在开放的亚空间频道中向我们传送了一条问候性的信息。
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control!

Evidently, the L-Cluster is home to some kind of advanced spacefaring civilization known as the "Dessanu Consonance." Now that the connection to their home cluster has been restored, the Dessanu have transmitted reactivation codes to all remaining L-Gates in the galaxy.

They are also transmitting a greeting message on an open subspace channel.

texts.zh:
星系中的各位居民，德萨努协和国问候你！

你们发现的被遗弃的星门和L-星门，都是许久许久之前由我们建造的。我们本想在全星系建造一个由这些设备构成的网络，然而事不遂人愿：由于一个不幸的错误导致L-星门无法使用，我们被困在了自己的母星团之中。

但这孤立时代终于结束了，一切都多亏了[From.From.GetName]的天才科学家！既然L-星门已经打开，我们邀请所有人随意免费使用，以便缩短星际旅行的时间。我们的星团向所有人开放。

但[lcluster_factory_system.GetName]恒星系除外。请务必不要前往该恒星系。
texts.en:
Denizens of the galaxy, greetings from the Dessanu Consonance!

Eons ago, we oversaw the construction of the Gateways and L-Gates that you may have seen abandoned. Our intention was to build a galactic network of such devices, but alas: a horrible mistake rendered the L-Gates unusable, stranding us in our home cluster.

But this Age of Isolation has finally come to an end, thanks to the clever scientists of the [From.From.GetName]! Now that the L-Gates are active again, we invite everyone to make free use of them to shorten galactic travel times. Our star cluster is open to everyone.

Except for the [lcluster_factory_system.GetName] system. Do not go there.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]在自己境内成功地恢复了某种远古亚空间传送门的电源，现在他们能到达我们星系边缘的某个被隔离的星团了！这个星团被他们称为“L-星团”，这个星团无法经由超空间抵达，只能通过这些L-星门。

目前看来，L-星团似乎是某个被称为“德萨努协和国”的先进太空文明的家园。现在通往他们母星团的连接已经恢复，德萨努人已对整个宇宙中的L-星门发送了重启代码。

他们也在开放的亚空间频道中向我们传送了一条问候性的信息。
texts.en:
By restoring power to some sort of ancient subspace gateway within their borders, the [From.GetName] has gained access to an isolated star cluster on the periphery of our galaxy! This group of stars, which they refer to as the "L-Cluster," cannot be reached by hyperlane - only through these L-Gates.

Evidently, the L-Cluster is home to some kind of advanced spacefaring civilization known as the "Dessanu Consonance." Now that the connection to their home cluster has been restored, the Dessanu have transmitted reactivation codes to all remaining L-Gates in the galaxy.

They are also transmitting a greeting message on an open subspace channel.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]已经成功开启了L-星团，却意外地发现它已经被一个名叫德萨努协和国的高等文明占据了！
texts.en: The [From.GetName] have successfully unlocked the L-Cluster, only to reveal that it is already inhabited by an advanced civilization known as the Dessanu Consonance!

texts.zh:
成功了！我们的技术人员移除了位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门的维护机制。

我们将是这亿万年来第一批从我们的星系进入L-星团的人！
texts.en:
Success! Our technicians managed to abort the maintenance cycle, and the lockdown has been removed from the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system.

For the first time in eons, the L-Cluster can now be accessed from our galaxy!

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的L-星团了。

但这样一来，我们就无法启动我们这个星系的L-星门了。现在除了已经可以正常使用的那个L-星门之外，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。

现在如果我们想前往遥远星团的话，只能使用[From.GetName]掌控之下的那个传送门了！
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant L-Cluster.

Unfortunately, this has halted our own project to activate an L-Gate. Aside from the one that is functional, all other L-Gates in the galaxy have now activated some sort of self-correcting software that should terminate their maintenance cycles within a matter of years.

For now, however, the only way to reach the star cluster is through the gate belonging to the [From.GetName]!

texts.zh: [From.GetName]在自己境内成功地恢复了某种远古亚空间传送门的电源，现在他们能到达我们星系边缘的某个被隔离的星团了！这个星团被他们称为“L-星团”，这个星团无法经由超空间抵达，只能通过这些L-星门。
texts.en: By restoring power to some sort of ancient subspace gateway within their borders, the [From.GetName] has gained access to an isolated star cluster on the periphery of our galaxy! This group of stars, which they refer to as the "L-Cluster," cannot be reached by hyperlane - only through these L-Gates.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的星团了。

在他们的L-星门恢复正常使用的那一刻起，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant L-Cluster.

As an apparent side-effect of this, all the other L-Gates in the galaxy are showing increased signs of activity as well. At the rate their self-correcting software is making adjustments, their maintenance cycles should also terminate within a matter of years.
